name: Ada
summary: AI customer service agent that resolves requests on every channel.
description: Ada deploys an AI agent that answers customers over chat, email, messaging and phone, using the company's knowledge base and systems. It can take real actions such as order tracking or refunds, and hands off to a human when needed.
